decisions.reason: This skin-and-hair supplement remains close to the firm's pharmacy-based consumer-health knowledge base, so despite weak later visibility the firm can still learn from sales feedback and support it with existing marketing and quality capabilities.

The joint-health supplement is related to existing consumer-health capabilities, but its limited prominence and missing later evidence suggest weaker market traction, making resource reallocation more attractive.

The mushroom-based immune supplement is the most niche and uncertain of the related supplements, and the firm's absorptive capacity is unlikely to justify continued effort without clearer commercial signals.

Even with the earlier valsartan-related problem, a generic blood-pressure medicine fits the firm's strong manufacturing, regulatory, analytical, and remediation capabilities well enough that continuation is more likely than withdrawal.

The OTC migraine triptan is more distant from the firm's established learning base than its core consumer-health and generics products, and the lack of visible follow-through after launch makes discontinuation the more likely portfolio decision.
